title: Unit tests for `shard-library.mjs` (all 6 APIs)
description: Create `tests/shard-library.test.mjs`. Cover every public API: `loadLibraries` (legacy synth, multi-library, malformed), `locateShard` (found, missing, wrong dir), `updateShard` (atomic write, mutator returning invalid shape, file-not-found), `rebuildLibrary` (success path mocked, failure path with non-zero exit), `resolveStatusVocab` (gen-tasklist, gen-issues, ambiguous enum, missing schema, statusMap override), `scanLinks` (explicit field, keyword scan, union, unknown prefix). Aim for ≥90% coverage on the helper module.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage report shows ≥90% lines + branches for `scripts/shard-library.mjs`
Every error path has a negative test
Tests use fixtures from TASK-002, no external network
